tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rigs lam spyi'i rnam gzhag legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer bzhugs// bstan pa'i bdag po bu ram shing pa mchog /bstan pa'i mig gcig rgyal sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /bstan pa'i srol 'byed phyogs glang chos kyi grags/ /bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan de rnams spyi bos mchod/ /'jam dbyangs ngo bo sa skya'i rje btsun mchog /'jam dpal gsung skyes lnga rig 'bum phrag gsum/ /'jam mgon rnam 'phrul phyogs las rnam rgyal zhabs/ /'jam dbyangs dges mdzad rnams kyis bdag skyongs shig rigs pa'i gnam lcags rigs pa'i rnam gzhag 'di/ /rigs pa'i gter bzhin rigs pa'i rnam grangs rnams/ /rigs par bkral nas rigs ldan dpa' bo la/ /rigs pa smra ba'i klu sgrub bdag gis 'chad/ /'dir rigs pa'i rnam gzhag 'chad pa la/ shes bya spyi ldog nas gtan la dbab pa dang / shes byed tshad ma'i rang bzhin bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la gsum/ shes bya'i yul bshad pa/ shes byed kyi blo bshad pa/ blo des yul rtogs tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po 'chad pa la/ yul la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni blos rig par bya ba de yul gyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa khyab mnyam pa ni/ yul dang shes gzhal gzhi grub yod/ /dmigs pa chos khams skye mched dang / /rten 'brel brjod bya bcu gcig po/ /yin yod mnyam pa'i khyab mnyam yin/ /zhes pa ltar bcu gcig po de yin khyab mnyam dang yod khyab mnyam yin no/ /'on kyang dngos smra ba'i skabs su rten 'brel dang / 'dus byas don gcig tu bshad na legs shing / dbu ma'i skabs su yang dpyad pa byar yod do/ /gsum pa dbye ba la/ spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ snang yul/ zhen yul/ 'jug yul/ gzung yul bshad pa'o/ /dang po la mtshan nyid khyab mnyam dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rtog med shes pa la gsal bar snang ba'i sgo nas rig par bya ba de snang yul gyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni snang yul/

shes bya yul gsum po don gcig gsum pa dbye ba la/ rtog med shes pa'i snang yul dang / 'phags pa'i snang yul gnyis/ des na khyod rtog med shes pa dang / 'phags pa gang rung yin na khyod kyi snang yul yod pas khyab/ rtog pa dang so skye gang rung yin na khyod kyi snang yul med pas khyab/ gnyis pa zhen yul la mtshan nyid khyab mnyam dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rtog pas zhen nas rig par bya ba zhen yul gyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa khyab mnyam pa ni/ zhen yul/ yul/ shes bya dang gsum don gcig gsum pa dbye na/ rtog pa'i zhen yul/ so so skye bo'i zhen yul/ rjod byed kyi sgra don mthun gyi zhen yul dang gsum/ des na/ rtog pa don mthun so so skye bo/ rjod byed kyi sgra don mthun gsum po gang rung yin na khyod kyi zhen yul yod pas khyab/ rtog med shes pa/ 'phags pa/ rtog pa don mi mthun/ rjod byed kyi sgra don mi mthun bzhi po gang rung yin na khyod kyi zhen yul med pas khyab/ gsum pa 'jug yul la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ yul can don mthun la brten nas skyes bu'i 'jug par bya ba 'jug yul gyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa khyab mnyam ni/ 'jug yul/ shes bya/ yul gsum po don gcig gsum pa dbye ba la/ tshad ma'i 'jug yul/ bcad shes kyi 'jug yul/ rjod byed kyi sgra don mthun gyi 'jug yul skyes bu'i 'jug yul dang bzhi/ des na de bzhi gang rung yin na khyod kyi 'jug yul yod pas khyab/ blo don mi mthun dang / the tshom don mi mthun dang / bag la nyal gyi the tshom don mi mthun dang / rjod byed kyi sgra don mi mthun bzhi gang rung yin na khyod kyi 'jug yul med pas khyab/ gnyis pa bye brag tu bshad pa la gsum/ phung khams skye mched kyi rnam gzhag gzhal bya rang spyi gnyis kyi rnam gzhag yul bden gnyis kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa'o/ /dang po la phung po bshad pa/

khams bshad pa/ skye mched bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po phung po la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ du ma spungs pa'i rigs su gnas pa de phung po'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa khyab mnyam pa ni/ dngos byas mi rtag rgyu rkyen 'bras/ /'dus byas phung po gzhan dbang rdzas/ /rang mtshan zhes bya bcu gcig po/ /yin yod mnyam pa'i khyab mnyam yin/ /zhes pa ltar bcu gcig po de khyab mnyam/ gsum pa dbye ba la/ gzugs kyi phung po/ tshor ba'i phung po/ 'du shes kyi phung po/ 'du byed kyi phung po/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang lnga/ dang po la mtshan nyid/ rnam grangs/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gzugs rung du ma spungs pa'i rigs su gnas pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugs phung dang bem po don gcig gsum pa dbye na/ gzugs sogs don lnga dang mig sogs dbang po lnga ste bcu/ de yang rim pa ltar/ rang 'bras gzugs 'dzin dbang sngon gyi gzung don byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i phyi'i rdul du grub pa de gzugs kyi mtshan nyid/ gzugs/ gzugs kyi khams/ gzugs kyi skye mched/ gzugs kyi rdul du grub pa bzhi don gcig mdo sde pa'i skabs 'dir/ gzugs can lhag ma dgu/ gzugs can yin yang gzugs ma yin la/ bye brag smra ba'i lugs la gzugs/ gzugs can bem po gsum don gcig pa ni grub mtha' mi 'dra ba'i khyad par du go dgos so/ /de bzhin du mnyan bya sgra'i mtshan nyid/ sgra/ sgra'i khams/ sgra'i skye mched gsum don gcig rang 'bras dri 'dzin mngon sum gyi gzung don byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa de dri'i mtshan nyid/ dri/ dri'i khams/ dri'i skye mched gsum don gcig rang 'bras ro 'dzin mngon sum gyi gzung don byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa de ro'i mtshan nyid/ ro/ ro'i khams/ ro'i skye mched gsum don gcig rang 'bras reg 'dzin mngon sum gyi gzung don byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa de reg bya'i mtshan nyid/

reg bya/ reg bya'i khams/ reg bya'i skye mched gsum don gcig de dag gi dbye ba 'chad pa la/ gzugs la dbye na/ sngo ser dkar dmar ring thung dang / /lham pa zlum pa mtho dman dang / /phyal le phyal le ma yin dang / /sprin dang du ba rdul khug sna/ /grib ma nyi ma snang mun no/ /zhes pa ltar nyi shu yod/ de dag kyang bsdus na dbyibs kyi gzugs dang kha dog gi gzugs gnyis su 'dus so/ /sgra la dbye na/ zin pa'i 'byung ba la brten pa'i sgra sems can du ston pa snyan mi snyan gnyis/ zin pa'i 'byung ba la brten pa'i sgra sems can du mi ston pa snyan mi snyan gnyis/ ma zin pa'i 'byung ba la brten pa'i sgra sems can du ston pa snyan mi snyan gnyis/ ma zin pa'i 'byung ba la brten pa'i sgra sems can du mi ston pa snyan mi snyan gnyis te brgyad/ de dag kyang rjod byed kyi sgra dang rjod byed ma yin pa'i sgra gnyis su 'dus so/ /dri la dbye na/ dri zhim pa mi zhim pa mnyam pa mi mnyam pa dang bzhi/ ro la dbye na/ mngar skyur lan tshwa tsha ba dang / /kha ba dang ni bska ba'o/ /zhes pa ltar drug de dag kyang phye na ro brgya dang brgyad du 'gyur te/ rtsa ba'i ro drug la/ mngar ba'i mngar ba sogs drug drug tu phye bas so drug /so drug po de la nus pa'i sgo nas gsum gsum du phye bas brgya dang brgyad 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /reg bya la dbye na/ 'byung bzhi 'jam rtsub lci yang grang / /bkres skom bcu gcig bdag nyid do/ /zhes pa ltar bcu gcig des na gzugs sogs don lnga gang rung yin na bem po yin pas khyab bo/ /rang gi bdag 'bras su gyur pa'i mig shes kyi bdag rkyen byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i nang gi rdul dwangs pa de mig gi dbang po gzugs can pa'i mtshan nyid/ mig dbang / mig dbang gzugs can pa/ mig gi khams/ mig gi skye mched bzhi don gcig de bzhin du rang gi bdag 'bras su gyur pa'i nyan shes/

sna shes/ lce shes/ lus shes kyi bdag rkyen byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i nang gi rdul dwangs pa de/ rna ba'i dbang po/ sna'i dbang po/ lce'i dbang po/ lus kyi dbang po bzhi'i mtshan nyid/ rna ba'i dbang po/ rna ba'i dbang po gzugs can pa/ rna ba'i khams/ rna ba'i skye mched bzhi don gcig pa sogs rigs 'gre/ mig sogs dbang po lnga la dbye na/ rten bcas dang / de mtshungs kyi mig dbang sogs gnyis gnyis yod/ des na mig sogs dbang po lnga po gang rung yin na nang bem yin pas khyab bo/ /gzugs kyi phung po las phye ba'i bcu po de yang bsdu na/ 'byung ba dang 'byung 'gyur gnyis su 'dus te/ reg bya ma gtogs pa'i gzugs sogs don bzhi mig sogs dbang po lnga dang bcas pa'i dgu po gang rung yin na 'byung 'gyur yin pas khyab/ reg bya'i nang tshan sa khams chu khams me khams rlung khams bzhi po gang rung yin na 'byung ba yin pas khyab/ sa chu me rlung bzhi gang rung ma yin pa'i reg bya yin na yang 'byung 'gyur yin pas khyab bo/ /mig sogs dbang po lnga dang sgra dang drug po gang rung yin na rags pa yin pas khyab/ lhag ma bzhi/ 'byung bzhi dang bcas pa'i rdul rdzas brgyad la rdul phran dang rags pa gnyis gnyis yod do/ /gnyis pa tshor ba'i phung po la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sim gdung bar ma ci rigs par rang stobs kyis nyams su myong ba'i rig pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ tshor ba dang tshor ba'i phung po gnyis don gcig gsum pa dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas tshor ba bde ba/ sdug bsngal/ btang snyoms gsum/ rten gyi sgo nas lus tshor dang sems tshor gnyis/ lus tshor dang dbang shes su gyur pa'i tshor ba gnyis don gcig sems tshor dang yid shes su gyur pa'i tshor ba gnyis don gcig gsum pa 'du shes kyi phung po la mtshan nyid khyab mnyam dbye ba dang gsum/ rang yul gyi spu ris mi 'dra bar rang stobs kyis 'byed pa'i sems byung de de'i mtshan nyid/

gnyis pa ni 'du shes kyi phung po dang / 'du shes don gcig gsum pa dbye na mig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i 'du shes nas/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i 'du shes kyi bar drug gsum pa 'du byed kyi phung po la mtshan nyid khyab mnyam dbye ba dang gsum/ phung po gzhan bzhi gang rung ma yin pa'i 'du byas de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ 'du byed kyi phung po dang / phung po gzhan bzhi gang rung ma yin pa'i 'dus byas gnyis don gcig gsum pa dbye na mtshungs ldan 'du byed kyi phung po dang / mtshungs ldan ma yin pa'i 'du byed kyi phung po gnyis/ dang po dang / tshor 'du gang rung ma yin pa'i sems byung gnyis don gcig gnyis pa dang / shes pa min par gyur pa'i 'du byed kyi phung po gnyis don gcig lnga pa rnam shes kyi phung po la mtshan nyid khyab mnyam dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang yul gyi ngo bo rang stobs kyis rig pa'i gtso bo rnam rig de de'i mtshan nyid/ rnam shes kyi phung po/ rnam shes/ rnam rig yid dbang / gtso sems/ sems/ yid kyi khams/ yid kyi skye mched rnams don gcig gsum pa dbye na/ mig gi rnam shes/ rna ba'i rnam shes/ sna'i rnam shes/ lce'i rnam shes/ lus kyi rnam shes/ yid kyi rnam shes dang drug yod/ /gnyis pa khams la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni nyer spyod 'dzin pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ khams skye mched shes bya gsum don gcig gsum pa dbye na dmigs pa yul gyi khams drug rten bdag rkyen gyi khams drug brten pa rnam par shes pa'i khams drug dang po ni/ gzugs kyi khams/ sgra'i khams/ dri'i khams/ ro'i khams/ reg bya'i khams/ chos kyi khams dang drug la 'jog dang po lnga bshad zin/ drug pa chos kyi khams la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang yul du byed pa'i drug pa yid kyi rnam par rig pa'i dmigs pa byed pa'i yul gyi khams drug pa de de'i mtshan nyid/

gnyis pa ni/ chos khams dang / tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed kyi phung po gsum 'dus ma byas dang bzhi po gang rung du gyur pa'i shes bya don gcig gsum pa dbye na sems sems byung gang rung du gyur pa'i chos khams dang / 'dus ma byas su gyur pa'i chos khams dang gnyis/ /gnyis pa bdag rkyen gyi khams drug ni/ mig gi khams/ rna ba'i khams/ sna'i khams/ lce'i khams/ lus kyi khams/ yid kyi khams dang drug la 'jog gsum pa brten pa'i khams drug ni/ mig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams nas/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi bar drug la 'jog rtsa ba'i gsum pa skye mched la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rnam shes skye ba'i sgo 'byed pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa khyab mnyam bshad zin/ gsum pa dbye na/ gzugs kyi skye mched nas chos kyi skye mched kyi bar drug dang / mig gi skye mched nas yid kyi skye mched kyi bar drug ste bcu gnyis yod/ dang po drug la phyi'i skye mched dang / phyi ma drug la nang gi skye mched yin pas khyab bo/ /gnyis pa gzhal bya rang spyi gnyis kyi rnam gzhag la/ rang mtshan bshad pa dang spyi mtshan bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ don dam par don byed nus pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni de dang dngos po don gcig gsum pa dbye na bem shes ldan min 'du byed gsum/ gnyis pa spyi mtshan la mtshan nyid khyab mnyam dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ don dam par don byed mi nus pa'i chos de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni spyi mtshan dang / 'dus ma byas kyi shes bya don gcig gsum pa dbye na/ dgag pa dang / sgrub par gyur pa'i spyi mtshan gnyis yod/ /gsum pa yul bden gnyis kyi rnam gzhag 'chad pa la/ kun rdzob bden pa dang / don dam bden pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rigs pas dpyad bzod du ma grub pa'i rtog pas sgro btags pa'i chos de de'i mtshan nyid/

gnyis pa ni de dang spyi mtshan don gcig gsum pa dbye ba spyi mtshan dang 'dra/ /gnyis pa shes byed kyi blo 'chad pa la/ blo la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni rig pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ rig pa/ blo/ shes pa/ gsal zhing rig pa bzhi don gcig gsum pa dbye na/ ngo bo yul dang 'dzin stangs dang / /bdag rkyen 'jug tshul mtshungs ldan gyi/ /sgo nas blo yi dbye sgo drug /ces pa ltar dbye sgo drug yod pa'i dang po ngo bo'i sgo nas tshad ma dang tshad min gyi blo gnyis/ dang po 'og tu 'chad/ gnyis pa tshad min gyi blo la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gsar du mi bslu ba ma yin pa'i rig pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ tshad min gyi blo/ ma rtogs pa'i blo gnyis don gcig gsum pa dbye na/ ma rtogs pa'i blo/ log shes/ the tshom dang gsum/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang yul de dang de min gang rung gsar du rtogs pas stong ba'i rig pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa dbye na/ rang yul la ma zhugs nas ma rtogs pa'i blo/ zhugs kyang tshol ba'i bya ba ma rdzogs pa nas ma rtogs pa'i blo/ rdzogs kyang ma rnyed nas ma rtogs pa'i blo dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rtog ge mi shes pa'i gang zag la tshul gsum gyi 'gro ldog dris pa'i tshe tshul gsum la rmongs pa'i blo lta bu la byed de/ sngar dpyad pa cher ma zhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa'i mtshan gzhi ni sgra rtag mi rtag dris pa na de gzod dpyod snyam pa'i blo lta bu la byed de/ dpyad pa cung zad zhugs kyang bya ba ma rdzogs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa la rtogs bya'i yul med nas ma rtogs pa'i blo/ rtogs byed kyi blos bslad nas ma rtogs pa'i blo/ shes bya'i yul ma yin nas ma rtogs pa'i blo dang gsum/ dang po'i mtshan gzhi ni bcad shes lta bu la byed de/ des kho rang gi yul rtogs kyang gsar du ma rtogs pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa ni grangs can gyi rgyud kyi sgra skad cig mar ma rtogs pa'i blo lta bu la byed de/ sgra rtag 'dzin gyi log rtog gis bslad pa zhugs nas de ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ yul gyis bskal pa 'phags yul rdo rje gdan ma rtogs pa'i blo lta bu dang / rang bzhin gyis bskal pa mdun gyi gzhi 'dir 'dre sha za ma rtogs pa'i blo lta bu dang / dus kyis bskal pa 'das ma 'ongs kyi dngos po ma rtogs pa'i blo lta bu dang gsum yod do/ /gnyis pa log shes la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ myong ba dang khyab pa 'gal ba'i rtags gang rung la brten nas rang yul phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa'i rig pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa dbye na/ rtog pa log shes dang / rtog med log shes gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ khyab pa 'gal ba'i rtags la brten nas rang yul phyin ci log tu mtha' gcig tu 'dzin pa'i zhen rig de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa dbye na/ yul la 'khrul ba'i rtog pa log shes/ dus la 'khrul ba'i rtog pa log shes/ rnam pa la 'khrul ba'i rtog pa log shes dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sgra rtag 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang / sha pa dang tsandan gcig tu 'dzin pa'i rtog pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ nyin phyed la mtshan phyed du 'khrul ba'i rtog pa log shes lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni/ thag khra la sbrul du 'khrul ba'i rtog pa lta bu la byed/ /gnyis pa rtog med log shes la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ myong ba la brten nas rang yul phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa'i gsal snang can gyi rig pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa dbye na/ rtog med dbang shes 'khrul ba dang / rtog med yid shes 'khrul ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ zla gcig la zla ba gnyis su snang ba'i dbang shes dang / skra shad 'dzag snang gi dbang shes lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugs gsal bar snang ba'i rmi lam gyi shes pa lta bu la byed/

gsum pa the tshom la mtshan nyid khyab mnyam dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang yul la mtha' gnyis su dogs pa'i zhen rig de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni the tshom/ som nyi/ mtha' gnyis su dogs pa'i zhen rig the tshom mngon gyur ba dang bzhi don gcig gsum pa dbye na/ sgra'i brjod rigs kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang 'dzin stangs kyi sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ the tshom mngon gyur ba dang / the tshom bag la nyal gnyis/ dang po dang the tshom don gcig gnyis pa la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ dngos btags dpyad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sgrub byed la ma brten par rang yul tshod dpags kyis mtha' gcig tu 'dzin pa'i ma nges pa'i sgrub byed ltar snang la brten nas rang yul mtha' gcig tu 'dzin pa'i zhen rig de'i mtshan nyid yin/ des na gzhung lugs kyi dgongs pa bskyangs na/ 'gal rtags la brten pa'i blo log shes/ ma nges pa'i rtags la brten pa'i blo bag la nyal gyi the tshom/ rtags la brten pa'i blo rjes dpag yin zhing / ma grub pa'i rtags la brten nas blo rig gang yang mi skye ba yin no zhes nges par bya dgos so/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ rtags la ma brten pa'i bag la nyal gyi the tshom dang / rtags la brten pa'i bag la nyal gyi the tshom gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ rgyu mtshan med bzhin du pha mes kyi khron pa rnying pa na chu yod snyam du mtha' gcig tu 'dzin pa'i rtog pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhal bya'i rtags las sgra mi rtag pa'am/ rtag par 'dzin pa'i rtog pa lta bu dang / mnyan bya'i rtags las sgra mi rtag pa'am rtag par 'dzin pa'i rtog pa lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni/ bag la nyal gyi the tshom yin na/ the tshom ma yin pas khyab ste/ bag la nyal gyi the tshom yin na/ rang yul mtha' gcig tu 'dzin pa'i blo yin pas khyab/ the tshom yin na/ rang yul mtha' gnyis su dogs pa'i blo yin pas khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa the tshom la 'dzin stangs kyi sgo nas cha mnyam pa'i the tshom dang /

shas cher 'dzin pa'i the tshom gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgra rtag gam mi rtag snyam pa'i the tshom lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa la don 'gyur gyi the tshom dang / don mi 'gyur gyi the tshom gnyis/ dang po ni/ the tshom don mthun dang don gcig mtshan gzhi ni sgra rtag gam mi rtag phal cher mi rtag las che snyam pa'i the tshom lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa dang the tshom don mi mthun don gcig mtshan gzhi ni sgra rtag gam mi rtag phal cher rtag las che snyam pa'i the tshom lta bu la byed/ 'dir dka' ba'i gnas la dpyad na/ rang yul la mtha' gcig tu phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa'i blo yin na/ log shes yin pas khyab par thal/ rang yul la mtha' gnyis su dogs pa'i zhen rig yin na/ the tshom yin pas khyab pa'i phyir snyam na ma khyab/ ma grub na 'bud/ 'dod na/ gzhal bya sgra rtag par sgrub pa'i ma nges pa'i rtags su song ba la brten nas skyes pa'i sgra rtag 'dzin rtog pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na der thal/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod log shes min par thal/ khyod bag la nyal gyi the tshom yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na der thal/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rigs gter rang 'grel las/ bag la nyal ni sgrom nang gi sa bon lta bu rkyen dang phrad na nus pa yod pa ste/ de yang mnyan bya dang gzhal byas sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa la sogs pa ma nges pa'i rtag mtha' dag dang / zhes pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir/ yang sgra rtag 'dzin rtog pa yin na/ rtog par gyur pa'i log shes yin pas khyab par thal/ byas pa'i rtags las sgra rtag 'dzin gyi rtog pa yin na/ rtog par gyur pa'i log shes yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ ma grub na der thal/ byas pa sgra rtag par sgrub pa'i 'gal rtags su song ba la brten nas skyes pa'i sgra rtag 'dzin rtog pa yin na/ log shes yin pas khyab pa'i phyir zer na/ 'dir ma khyab zer dgos/

ma grub na der thal/ rigs gter las/ rtags su bkod pa bzhi ru nges/ /rtags su bkod pa bzhi po la/ /nus pa de yang rnam bzhi yod/ /ces pa'i gzhung don grub pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ gzhal bya sgra rtag par sgrub pa'i ma nges pa'i rtags su song ba la brten nas skyes pa'i sgra rtag 'dzin rtog pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags der thal/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na de chos can/ khyod rtog par gyur pa'i log shes min par thal/ khyod bag la nyal gyi the tshom yin pa'i phyir te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ yang tshad min gyi blo yin na/ nges shes/ log shes/ the tshom gsum po gang rung yin pas khyab par thal/ tshad min gyi blo yin na/ nges shes dang log shes/ the tshom/ bag la nyal gyi the tshom bzhi po gang rung yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bag la nyal gyi the tshom kun chos can du bzung nas gtong / rtsa bar ma khyab na/ rang yul la ma zhugs nas ma rtogs pa'i blo rnams chos can du bzung nas gtong na ci smra soms shig thal 'gyur snga ma'i rtsa ba la ma khyab na/ byas pa sgra rtag par sgrub pa'i ma nges pa'i rtags su song ba la brten nas skyes pa'i sgra rtag 'dzin rtog pa chos can/ rtog par gyur pa'i log shes yin par thal/ khyod byas pa'i rtags las sgra rtag 'dzin rtog pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags der thal/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na ma yin par thal/ bag la nyal gyi the tshom yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir 'ga' zhig bag la nyal gyi the tshom yin na/ the tshom yin pas khyab zer na/ bag la nyal gyi the tshom chos can/ khyod rang yul la mtha' gnyis su dogs pa'i zhen rig yin par thal/ khyod the tshom yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod the tshom mngon gyur ba yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na ma yin par thal/ bag la nyal gyi the tshom yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang / the tshom yin na/ the tshom don mthun dang / the tshom don mi mthun gang rung yin pas khyab par thal/

rtog pa yin na/ rtog pa don mthun dang / rtog pa don mi mthun gang rung yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sgra rtag gam mi rtag snyam pa'i cha mnyam pa'i the tshom chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod the tshom don mthun yin par thal/ khyod de gnyis gang rung gang zhig khyod the tshom don mi mthun min pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod don 'gyur gyi the tshom yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ khyod cha mnyam pa'i the tshom yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa rtags phyi ma ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod don mi 'gyur gyi the tshom yin par thal/ khyod the tshom don mi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ khyod cha mnyam pa'i the tshom yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa bar ma khyab na yang / sngar gyi chos can de nyid kyis gshags te btang bas chog go /blo'i dbye sgo gnyis pa yul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ rtog pa dang / rtog med shes pa gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ zhen rig de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ rtog pa/ zhen rig zhen blo/ sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rig pa/ snang rtags gcig 'dzin gyi rig pa/ ming don bsres 'dzin gyi rig pa dang lnga don gcig gsum pa dbye na/ rtog pa don mthun dang don mi mthun gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'dzin stangs don dang mthun pa'i zhen rig de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ rtog pa don mthun/ zhen yul can gyi rtog pa/ rang yul gyi gtso bo grub pa'i rtog pa gsum don gcig gsum pa dbye na/ nges shes/ the tshom don mthun/ bag la nyal gyi the tshom don mthun gsum/ dang po la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang yul nges pa'i zhen rig go /gnyis pa ni/ nges shes/ rang gi gzhal bya nges pa'i zhen rig de bzhin du/ rang gi rtogs bya/ rang gi zhen yul/ rang gi dmigs bya nges pa'i zhen rig rnams don gcig

gnyis pa dbye na/ rjes dpag dang / bcad shes gnyis/ bcad shes la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba dang gsum/ rtogs zin rtogs pa'i rig pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ bcad shes dran shes gnyis don gcig gsum pa ni/ de la dbye na mngon sum gyis drangs pa'i bcad shes dang / rjes dpag gis drangs nas skyes pa'i bcad shes gnyis yod do/ /gsum pa 'dzin stangs kyi sgo nas dbye na 'khrul shes dang / ma 'khrul shes gnyis/ dang po 'khrul shes la mtshan nyid khyab mnyam dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'khrul ba'i rig pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa khyab mnyam pa la/ 'khrul ba'i rig pa/ 'khrul shes/ mngon sum ltar snang / mngon sum ma yin par gyur pa'i shes pa dang bzhi po don gcig gsum pa dbye na/ rtog par gyur pa'i 'khrul shes dang / rtog med shes par gyur pa'i 'khrul shes gnyis/ dang po dang rtog pa gnyis don gcig gnyis pa rtog med shes par gyur pa'i 'khrul shes la/ rtog med dbang shes 'khrul ba dang / rtog med yid shes 'khrul ba gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan gzhi ni/ zla ba gnyis snang gi dbang shes/ skra shad 'dzag snang gi dbang shes dang / gangs ri g.yur snang gi dbang shes lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa'i mtshan gzhi ni/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs kyi rta glang gsal bar snang ba'i 'khrul shes lta bu la byed/ /gnyis pa/ ma 'khrul shes la mtshan nyid khyab mnyam dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ ma 'khrul ba'i rig pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa khyab mnyam la ma 'khrul shes/ ma 'khrul ba'i rig pa/ mngon sum/ mngon sum yang dag bzhi don gcig gsum pa dbye na dbang shes su gyur pa'i ma 'khrul shes dang / yid shes su gyur pa'i ma 'khrul shes gnyis/ dang po dang dbang mngon don gcig gnyis pa dang yid mngon don gcig /bzhi pa bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas dbang shes dang / yid shes gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i dbang po gzugs can pa la brten nas skyes pa'i dbang po'i rig pa de de'i mtshan nyid/

gnyis pa dbye ba la/ mig shes/ nyan shes/ sna shes/ lce shes/ lus shes dang lnga/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i mig dbang gzugs can pa la brten nas skyes pa'i mig gi rig pa de/ mig shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ 'dzin stangs kyi sgo nas mig shes 'khrul ba dang / mig shes ma 'khrul ba gnyis/ mtshungs ldan gyi sgo nas sems su gyur pa'i mig shes dang / sems byung du gyur pa'i mig shes gnyis/ ngo bo'i sgo nas/ dge ba/ mi dge ba/ lung ma bstan du gyur pa'i mig shes dang gsum/ des gzhan nyan shes sogs phyi ma bzhi la yang rigs 'gre /gnyis pa yid shes la mtshan nyid dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i yid dbang la brten nas skyes pa'i yid kyi rig pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ yul gyi sgo nas/ rtog par gyur pa'i yid shes dang / rtog med shes par gyur pa'i yid shes gnyis/ mtshungs ldan gyi sgo nas gtso sems su gyur pa'i yid shes dang / sems byung du gyur pa'i yid shes gnyis yod/ lnga pa 'jug tshul gyi sgo nas rang rig dang / gzhan rig gnyis/ dang po rang rig la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'dzin rnam rang rig gi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa khyab mnyam pa la/ rang rig 'dzin rnam/ kha nang bltas kyi shes pa/ 'dzin rnam rkyang bu ba'i shes pa/ blo tshul gnyis pa can ma yin pa'i shes pa dang lnga po don gcig gsum pa dbye na/ mtshungs ldan gyi sgo nas gtso sems su gyur pa'i rang rig dang / sems byung du gyur pa'i rang rig gnyis/ myong ba'i sgo nas/ rang gi myong bya rtog pa nyams su myong ba'i rang rig dang / rang gi myong bya rtog med shes pa nyams myong gi rang rig gnyis/ rten gang zag gi sgo nas so so skye bo'i rgyud kyi rang rig dang / 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi rang rig gnyis/

drug pa mtshungs ldan gyi sgo nas/ sems dang sems byung gnyis/ dang po sems byung la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang yul gyi ngo bo rang stobs kyis rig pa'i rnam rig de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa khyab mnyam la sems/ gtso sems/ rnam rig rnam shes/ yid kyi khams/ yid kyi skye mched/ yid dbang / yid dang brgyad po don gcig gsum pa dbye ba la/ mig gi rnam shes/ rna ba'i rnam shes/ sna'i rnam shes/ lce'i rnam shes/ lus kyi rnam shes/ drug pa yid kyi rnam shes/ kun gzhi/ nyon yid dang brgyad/ dang po la mtshan nyid/ khyab mnyam/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang gi bdag rkyen mig dbang la brten nas skyes pa'i mig gi rnam rig de mig gi rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa khyab mnyam pa la/ mig gi rnam shes/ mig gi rnam rig mig shes su gyur pa'i gtso sems gsum don gcig gsum pa dbye na/ mngon sum du gyur pa'i mig gi rnam shes dang / log shes su gyur pa'i mig gi rnam shes gnyis/ des lus kyi rnam shes kyi bar bzhi la yang rigs 'gre/ drug pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa la mtshan nyid khyab mnyam dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ drug pa yid kyi rnam rig de/ drug pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa ni/ drug pa yid kyi rnam shes dang / drug pa yid shes su gyur pa'i gtso sems gnyis don gcig gsum pa dbye ba la/ yul gyi sgo nas rtog par gyur pa'i drug pa yid kyi rnam shes dang / rtog med shes par gyur pa'i drug pa yid kyi rnam shes gnyis/ 'dzin stangs kyi sgo nas 'khrul shes su gyur pa'i drug pa yid kyi rnam shes dang / ma 'khrul shes su gyur pa'i drug pa yid kyi rnam shes gnyis/ ngo bo'i sgo nas/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan du gyur pa'i drug pa yid kyi rnam shes gsum/ bdun pa kun gzhi'i rnam shes la/ mtshan nyid khyab mnyam dbye ba khyad chos dang bzhi/

dang po ni/ rtsa ba'i rnam rig de/ kun gzhi'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa ni/ kun gzhi rtsa ba'i rnam rig rtsa ba'i rnam shes/ sa bon thams cad pa'i rnam shes dang / rnam par smin pa'i rnam shes dang / len pa'i rnam shes dang / drug po don gcig gsum pa dbye ba la/ kun gzhi sa bon gyi cha dang / kun gzhi rnam smin gyi cha gnyis yod cing / de gnyis dang kun gzhi don gcig ngo bo dmigs rnam 'jug ldog dang / /'khor dang sa yi khyad par bdun/ /zhes pa ltar bdun yod pa'i dang po ngo bo'i khyad par la/ kun gzhi yin na lung ma bstan yin pas khyab/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu yin pas khyab/ mngon sum yin pas khyab/ de'i nang nas gzhan rig gi yid mngon yin pas khyab bo/ /gnyis pa dmigs pa ni/ kun gzhi des brtan g.yo thams cad la phyogs dang ris su ma chad par dmigs so/ /gsum pa rnam pa ni/ kun gzhi de rang gi dmigs pa brtan g.yo kun la dmigs nas phra zhing mi gsal ba'i rnam pa can yin/ bzhi pa 'jug tshul ni/ kun gzhi de sems can gyi gnas skabs su rgyun ma chad par 'jug pa yin te/ sems can yin na kun gzhi'i rnam shes rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yin dgos pa'i phyir/ lnga pa ldog tshul ni/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes de/ sangs rgyas thob nas nges par ldog ste/ kun gzhi de/ me long lta bu'i ye shes su gnas 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /drug pa 'khor ni/ kun gzhi'i 'khor du sems byung kun 'gro lnga kho na 'byung ste/ de'i 'khor du byung ba'i sems byung yin na kun 'gro lnga po gang rung yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /bdun pa sa'i khyad par ni/ kun gzhi de/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag dang sa mtshungs te/ 'dod pa khams pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi kun gzhi yin na/ 'dod pa'i sas bsdus yin pas khyab/ gzugs khams pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi kun gzhi yin na/ gzugs kyi sas bsdus yin pas khyab/ gzugs med khams pa'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi kun gzhi yin na/

gzugs med kyi sas bsdus yin pas khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /brgyad pa nyon yid la mtshan nyid dbye ba/ khyad chos dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang gi dmigs pa kun gzhi la dmigs nas rtag tu ngar sems pa'i sgrib lung ma bstan gyi gtso bo rnam rig de de'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ 'dod khams kyi nyon yid/ gzugs khams kyi nyon yid/ gzugs med khams kyi nyon yid dang gsum/ gsum pa khyad chos la/ ngo bo dmigs rnam 'jug ldog drug /'khor dang sa yi khyad par bdun/ /zhes pa ltar bdun yod pa'i dang po ngo bo ni/ nyon yid yin na lung ma bstan yin pas khyab/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po yin pas khyab bo/ /gnyis pa dmigs pa ni/ kun gzhi de/ nyon yid kyi dmigs pa yin/ gsum pa rnam pa ni/ kun gzhi la dmigs nas nga'o snyam pa'i rnam pa can yin/ bzhi pa 'jug tshul ni/ nyon yid de so so skye bo'i gnas skabs su rgyun ldan par 'jug ste/ so so skye bo yin na/ nyon yid rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa ldog pa'i dus ni/ nyon yid de/ theg naman dgra bcom pa dang / theg chen gyi mthong lam thob nas nges par ldog ste/ theg chen dgra bcom pa dang / theg chen 'phags pa gang rung yin na/ nyon yid spangs pa'i gang zag yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /drug pa 'khor ni/ nyon yid kyi 'khor du sems byung dgu kho na 'byung ba yin te/ nyon yid kyi 'khor du byung ba'i sems byung yin na/ kun 'gro lnga dang 'dod chags ma rig pa nga rgyal lta ba dgu po gang rung yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /bdun pa sa'i khyad par ni/ nyon yid de rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag dang sa mtshungs te/ 'dod pa khams pa'i rgyud kyi nyon yid yin na/ 'dod pa'i sas bsdus yin pas khyab/ gzugs khams pa'i rgyud kyi nyon yid yin na gzugs kyi sas bsdus yin pas khyab/ gzugs med khams pa'i rgyud kyi nyon yid yin na/

gzugs med kyi sas bsdus yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ /gnyis pa sems byung la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ khyad chos dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang yul gyi khyad par rang stobs kyis mthong ba'i rig pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ kun 'gro lnga/ yul nges lnga/ dad sogs dge ba bcu gcig rtsa nyon drug nye nyon nyi shu/ gzhan 'gyur bzhi ste lnga bcu rtsa gcig yod/ dang po kun 'gro lnga 'chad pa la/ tshor 'du sems pa reg yid byed/ /'di dag kun 'gro lnga yin te/ /zhes pa ltar lnga yod pa'i/ sim gdung bar ma gsum ci rigs par rang stobs kyis myong ba'i rig pa de tshor ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na mig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba/ de bzhin du rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba dang drug yod/ de yang dang po lnga po gang rung yin na lus tshor yin pas khyab/ lus tshor dang / dbang shes su gyur pa'i tshor ba don gcig drug pa yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba yin na/ sems tshor yin pas khyab/ sems tshor dang / yid shes su gyur pa'i tshor ba don gcig lus tshor dang sems tshor de gnyis char la/ tshor ba bde ba/ sdug bsngal/ btang snyoms gsum gsum yod do/ /kun 'gro gang rung gang zhig rang yul gyi spu ris mi 'dra bar rang stobs kyis mthong ba'i rig pa de 'du shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na mig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i 'du shes nas/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i 'du shes kyi bar drug yod/ kun 'gro lnga po gang rung gang zhig rang yul la sems rang stobs kyis g.yo ba'i rig pa de sems pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na mig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i sems pa sogs drug yod/

yul dbang rnam shes gsum 'dus nas yul gyi 'gyur ba rang stobs kyis gcod par byed pa'i rig pa de/ reg pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na mig gi 'dus te reg pa la sogs pa drug yod/ kun 'gro lnga po gang rung gang zhig rang yul la rang stobs kyis 'du byed pa'i rig pa de yid la byed pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na mig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i yid la byed pa la sogs pa drug yod/ kun 'gro lnga po de la thun mong du dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum gsum/ bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas dbang shes dang yid shes gnyis gnyis/ khams kyi sgo nas khams gsum gyi gsum gsum yod do/ /gnyis pa yul nges lnga 'chad pa la/ 'dun mos dran ting shes rab ste/ /'di dag yul nges lnga yin no/ /zhes pa ltar lnga yod pa'i/ yul nges lnga po gang rung gang zhig rang yul rang stobs kyis don du gnyer ba'i sems byung / rang yul la rang stobs kyis nges par smon pa'i sems byung / rang yul gyi dmigs rnam rang stobs kyis ma brjed pa'i sems byung / rang yul la rang stobs kyis rtse gcig pa'i sems byung / rang yul la rang stobs kyis rnam par 'byed pa'i sems byung rnams rim bzhin de lnga'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum gsum/ bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas dbang shes dang yid shes gnyis gnyis/ khams kyi sgo nas khams gsum gyi gsum gsum yod do/ /gsum pa/ dad sogs dge ba bcu gcig ni/ /dad dang bag yod shin tu sbyangs/ /btang snyoms ngo tsha shes khrel yod/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug med/ /brtson 'grus rnam par mi 'tshe ba/ /dad sogs dge ba bcu gcig yin/ /zhes pa ltar dad pa/ bag yod/ shin sbyangs/ 'du byed btang snyoms/ ngo tsha shes pa'i sems byung / khrel yod pa'i sems byung / 'dod chags med pa'i sems byung / zhe sdang med pa'i sems byung /

gti mug med pa'i sems byung / brtson 'grus/ rnam par mi 'tshe ba dang bcu gcig po de la dge ba bcu gcig ces 'jog la/ de re re la ngo bo'i sgo nas/ zag bcas zag med gnyis gnyis/ rten gyi sgo nas dbang shes yid shes gnyis gnyis/ khams kyi sgo nas khams gsum gyi gsum gsum/ sa'i sgo nas sa dgu'i sas bsdus dgu dgu yod/ kha cig shin sbyangs la 'dod pa'i sas bsdus med zer ba yod kyang / dge ba bcu gcig las phye ba'i shin sbyangs dang / mnyam gzhag gis bsdus pa'i shin sbyangs khyad par can gyi rnam dbye ma phyed pa'i skyon yin pas yid gtad par mi bya'o/ /bzhi pa rtsa nyon drug ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /nga rgyal lta ba the tshom drug /nyon mongs rtsa nyon drug yin no/ /zhes pa ltar/ drug yod pa'i mtshan nyid rim pa ltar/ rtsa nyon gang zhig rang yul la rang stobs kyis lhag par chags pa'i rig pa/ gang zhig 'dra/ rang yul la rang stobs kyis kun nas mnar sems pa'i rig pa/ de gang zhig rang yul la rang stobs kyis lhag par rmongs pa'i rig pa/ de gang zhig rang yul la rang stobs kyis lhag par khengs pa'i rig pa/ de gang zhig rang yul la rang stobs kyis lhag par phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa'i rig pa/ de gang zhig rang yul la rang stobs kyis lhag par som nyi za ba'i rig pa rnams/ rim bzhin/ 'dod chags/ zhe sdang / gti mug nga rgyal/ rtsa nyon drug gi zlas phye ba'i lta ba/ de drug gi zlas phye ba'i the tshom rnams kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de drug gi zlas phye ba'i lta ba de la/ 'jig lta/ mthar lta/ log lta/ lta ba mchog tu 'dzin pa'i lta ba/ tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin gyi lta ba dang lngar phye bas/ rtsa nyon bcu yod la/ bcu po de la/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ zhe sdang la mi dge ba yin pas khyab/ lhag ma dgu la mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gnyis gnyis/ rten gyi sgo nas/ 'dod chags/

zhe sdang / gti mug gsum la dbang shes dang yid shes gnyis gnyis/ lhag ma bdun la yid shes yin pas khyab/ gnyen po'i sgo nas/ lta ba phyi ma gsum dang / rtsa nyon the tshom la mthong spang yin pas khyab/ lhag ma drug la mthong spang dang sgom spang gnyis gnyis yod/ sa'i sgo nas zhe sdang la 'dod pa'i sas bsdus yin pas khyab/ lhag ma dgu la sa dgu'i sas bsdus dgu dgu yod do/ /lnga pa nye nyon la bcu tshan gnyis yod pa'i dang po ni/ khro dang khon 'dzin 'tshig pa dang / /rnam 'tshe 'chab pa phrag dog dang / /ser sna g.yo sgyu rgyags pa rnams/ /nye nyon bcu tshan dang po yin/ /zhes pa ltar bcu yod pa'i/ dang po bdun la mi dge ba yin pas khyab/ phyi ma g.yo sgyu rgyags pa gsum la mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gnyis gnyis yod/ rten gyi sgo nas bcu char la yid shes yin pas khyab/ gnyen po'i sgo nas/ bcu char la mthong spang dang / sgom spang gnyis/ khams kyi sgo nas/ dang po bdun la 'dod pa'i sas bsdus yin pas khyab/ phyi ma gsum la khams gsum char gyi sas bsdus yod/ bcu tshan gnyis pa 'chad pa ni/ ngo tsha med dang khrel med dang / /ma dad le lo bag med dang / /rmugs rgod brjed nges shes bzhin min/ /rnam g.yeng zhes bya rnam pa bcu/ /nye nyon bcu tshan tha ma yin/ /zhes pa ltar bcu las/ dang po lnga la mi dge ba yin pas khyab/ phyi ma lnga la mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gnyis gnyis/ bcu char la rten gyi sgo nas dbang shes yid shes gnyis gnyis/ gnyen po'i sgo nas mthong spang dang / sgom spang gnyis gnyis/ khams kyi sgo nas/ dang po lnga la 'dod pa'i sas bsdus yin pas khyab/ phyi ma lnga la khams gsum char gyi sas bsdus yod do/ /drug pa gzhan 'gyur bzhi 'chad pa la/ gnyid 'gyod rtog dpyod gzhan 'gyur bzhi/ /zhes pa ltar bzhi la mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ gzhan 'gyur bzhi gang rung gang zhig sems kyi 'jug pa rang stobs kyis rang dbang med par sdud pa'i rig pa gnyid kyi mtshan nyid/

gang zhig rang gi bya ba rang stobs kyis yid la bcags pa'i rig pa 'gyod pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang gi dmigs pa la rang stobs kyis rtsing ba'i rnam pa can gyi rig pa gzhan 'gyur bzhi'i zlas phye ba'i rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang gi dmigs pa la rang stobs kyis zhib pa'i rnam pa can gyi rig pa de bzhi'i zlas phye ba'i dpyod pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ de bzhi la dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum gsum/ rten gyi sgo nas/ dang po gnyid 'gyod gnyis la yid shes yin pas khyab/ rtog dpyod gnyis la dbang shes dang yid shes gnyis gnyis/ khams kyi sgo nas/ gnyid 'gyod gnyis la 'dod pa'i sas bsdus yin pas khyab/ rtog dpyod gnyis la 'dod pa dang bsam gtan dang po gang rung gi sas bsdus yin pas khyab/ bzhi pa khyad chos 'chad pa la/ sems gang gi 'khor du sems byung du 'gro ba la dpyad pa/ mtshungs ldan rnam pa lnga mtshungs la dpyad pa/ khams dang sa gang na sems dang sems byung du yod la dpyad pa gsum/ dang po ni/ kun gzhi'i 'khor du kun 'gro lnga kho na 'byung gi yul nges lnga mi 'byung ste/ kun gzhi ni dmigs rnam ris su ma 'chad pa yin/ yul nges lnga ni dmigs rnam ris su chad pa'i phyir/ dge ba bcu gcig mi 'byung ste/ kun gzhi ni ma sgrib lung ma bstan yin/ dge ba bcu gcig lung ma bstan ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa nyon drug dang / nye nyon nyi shu mi 'byung ste/ kun gzhi ma sgrib lung ma bstan yin/ de rnams sgrib pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan 'gyur bzhi mi 'byung ste/ kun gzhi dmigs rnam brtan/ gzhan 'gyur bzhi dmigs rnam mi brtan pa'i phyir/ nyon yid kyi 'khor du/ kun 'gro lnga/ 'dod chags/ nga rgyal/ ma rig pa/ lta ba dang dgu kho na 'byung gi yul nges lnga de'i 'khor du mi 'byung ste/ yul nges lnga dmigs rnam so sor nges/ nyon yid dmigs rnam gcig tu nges pa'i phyir/

rtsa nyon drug las/ zhe sdang dang / the tshom gnyis de'i 'khor du mi 'byung ste/ zhe sdang yin na mi dge ba yin pas khyab/ nyon yid la lung ma bstan yin pas khyab pa'i phyir dang / the tshom yin na drug pa yid shes yin pas khyab/ nyon yid yin na drug pa yid shes min pas khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan/ nye nyon nyi shu dang / gzhan 'gyur bzhi yang mi 'byung ste/ de dag la drug pa yid kyi sa pa dang / dbang shes gang rung yin pas khyab/ nyon yid yin na dbang shes dang / drug yid gang rung ma yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ 'jug pa'i rnam shes la/ sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa dang / drug pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa gnyis yod pa'i/ dang po la/ yid ma gtad pa'i dbang po'i rnam par shes pa dang / yid gtad pa'i dbang po'i rnam par shes pa gnyis/ dang po'i 'khor du kun 'gro lnga kho na 'byung gi gzhan mi 'byung ste/ de'i rkyen ma tshang ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum yod pa'i dang po dge bar gyur pa'i dbang po'i rnam par shes pa'i 'khor du/ sems byung nyi shu rtsa gsum byung ste/ kun 'gro lnga/ yul nges lnga/ dad sogs dge ba bcu gcig rtog dpyod gnyis rnams 'byung ba'i phyir/ de'i 'khor du rtsa nyon drug nye nyon nyi shu dang bcas pa'i sems byung nyer drug mi 'byung ste/ kho dge ba gang zhig nyer drug po nyon mongs yin pa'i phyir/ de'i 'khor du gnyid 'gyod gnyis mi 'byung ste/ kho dbang shes gang zhig gnyid 'gyod gnyis la yid shes yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ mi dge bar gyur pa'i dbang po'i rnam par shes pa'i 'khor du sems byung nyer lnga 'byung ste/ kun 'gro lnga/ yul nges lnga/ rtsa nyon 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ nye nyon bcu tshan tha ma/ rtog dpyod gnyis dang bcas pa'i nyer lnga 'byung ba'i phyir/ de'i 'khor du dge ba bcu gcig mi 'byung ste/ kho mi dge ba yin pa'i phyir/ de'i 'khor du rtsa nyon phyi ma gsum/

nye nyon bcu tshan dang po/ gzhan 'gyur gnyid 'gyod gnyis dang bcas pa'i bco lnga mi 'byung ste/ kho dbang shes gang zhig bco lnga po gang rung yin na yid shes yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ lung ma bstan du gyur pa'i dbang po'i rnam par shes pa la/ bsgribs lung ma bstan dang / ma bsgribs lung ma bstan gnyis yod pa'i/ dang po bsgribs lung ma bstan gyi dbang po'i rnam par shes pa'i 'khor du/ sems byung bcu dgu 'byung ste/ kun 'gro lnga/ yul nges lnga/ rtsa nyon 'dod chags dang / gti mug gnyis/ nye nyon bcu tshan tha ma'i phyi ma lnga/ rtog dpyod gnyis dang bcas pa'i bcu dgu 'byung ba'i phyir/ de'i 'khor du/ dge ba bcu gcig mi 'byung ste/ kho lung ma bstan yin pa'i phyir/ de'i 'khor du/ rtsa nyon zhe sdang / nye nyon bcu tshan tha ma'i dang po lnga dang drug mi 'byung ste/ kho lung ma bstan gang zhig de drug la mi dge ba yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ de'i 'khor du rtsa nyon phyi ma gsum nye nyon bcu tshan dang po/ gnyid 'gyod gnyis dang bcas pa'i bco lnga mi 'byung ste/ kho dbang shes gang zhig de bco lnga la yid shes yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ma bsgribs lung ma bstan du gyur pa'i dbang po'i rnam par shes pa'i 'khor du sems byung bcu gnyis 'byung ste/ kun 'gro lnga/ yul nges lnga dang bcu/ rtog dpyod gnyis dang bcu gnyis byung ba'i phyir/ de'i 'khor du dge ba bcu gcig mi 'byung ste/ kho lung ma bstan yin pa'i phyir/ de'i 'khor du/ rtsa nyon drug nye nyon nyi shu dang bcas pa'i nyer drug mi 'byung ste/ kho ma bsgribs lung ma bstan gang zhig nyer drug po sgrib pa yin pa'i phyir/ de'i 'khor du/ gnyid 'gyod gnyis mi 'byung ste/ kho dbang shes gang zhig gnyid 'gyod gnyis la yid shes yin pas khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa drug pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa la/ rkyen nyer gnas kyi yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang /

yid sngon song gi drug pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa gnyis/ dang po'i 'khor du/ kun 'gro lnga kho na 'byung gi gzhan mi 'byung ste/ de 'byung ba'i rkyen ma tshang ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa de la dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum yod pa'i dang po/ dge bar gyur pa'i drug pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i 'khor du sems byung nyer lnga 'byung ste/ kun 'gro lnga/ yul nges lnga/ dge ba bcu gcig gzhan 'gyur bzhi dang bco lnga byung ba'i phyir/ de'i 'khor du/ rtsa nyon drug nye nyon nyi shu dang nyer drug mi 'byung ste/ kho dge ba gang zhig de nyer drug po nyon mongs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mi dge bar gyur pa'i drug pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i 'khor du/ sems byung bzhi bcu 'byung ste/ kun 'gro lnga/ yul nges lnga/ rtsa nyon drug nye nyon nyi shu/ gzhan 'gyur bzhi dang bcas pa'i bzhi bcu po 'byung ba'i phyir/ dge ba bcu gcig mi 'byung ste/ kho mi dge ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa lung ma bstan gyi drug yid la/ bsgribs lung ma bstan dang / ma bsgribs lung ma bstan gnyis/ dang po bsgribs lung ma bstan du gyur pa'i drug pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i 'khor du/ sems byung so dgu 'byung ste/ kun 'gro lnga/ yul nges lnga/ zhe sdang ma gtogs pa'i rtsa nyon lnga/ nye nyon nyi shu gzhan 'gyur bzhi dang bcas pa'i so dgu 'byung ba'i phyir/ de'i 'khor du/ dge ba bcu gcig dang / zhe sdang mi 'byung ste/ kho lung ma bstan gang zhig dge ba bcu gcig dang / zhe sdang / dge ba dang mi dge bar so sor nges pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ma bsgribs lung ma bstan du gyur pa'i drug pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i 'khor du sems byung bcu bzhi 'byung ste/ kun 'gro lnga yul nges lnga gzhan 'gyur bzhi dang bcas pa'i bcu bzhi 'byung ba'i phyir/ de'i 'khor du/ dge ba bcu gcig dang / rtsa nyon drug nye nyon nyi shu dang bcas pa'i so bdun mi 'byung ste/

kho ma bsgribs lung ma bstan gang zhig dge ba bcu gcig dge ba'i las yin/ rtsa nyon drug dang nye nyon nyi shu nyon sgrib yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir dogs pa 'di ltar dpyad dgos te/ khyod kyi 'khor du byung ba'i dad sogs dge ba bcu gcig kun 'gro lnga/ yul nges lnga/ rtog dpyod gnyis dang bcas pa'i nyer gsum yod par thal/ khyod dge bar gyur pa'i gtso sems yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la khyab pa yod par thal/ dge bar gyur pa'i gtso sems kyi 'khor du sems byung nyer gsum po de 'byung ba'i phyir zer na ma khyab/ 'dod na/ bsam gtan gnyis pa'i sas bsdus kyi dge bar gyur pa'i gtso sems chos can/ der thal de'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod kyi 'khor du byung ba'i rtog dpyod gnyis yod par thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ chos can yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang khyod kyi 'khor du byung 'ba'i dad sogs dge ba bcu gcig ma gtogs pa'i sems byung bzhi bcu yod par thal/ khyod mi dge bar gyur pa'i drug pa yid kyi rnam shes yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la khyab pa yod par thal/ mi dge bar gyur pa'i drug pa yid kyi rnam shes kyi 'khor du sems byung bzhi bcu 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mi dge bar gyur pa'i 'dod chags dang mtshungs ldan gyi drug pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa chos can/ der thal de'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ khyod kyi 'khor du 'byung ba'i zhe sdang yod par thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te chos can yin pa'i phyir dang / des na/ mi dge bar gyur pa'i drug pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i 'khor du sems byung bzhi bcu 'byung zhes pa de/ so sor 'byung srid pa la dgongs pa yin gyi/ thams cad cig car du 'byung ba ni ma yin te/ chags sdang gnyis gtso sems gcig gi 'khor du cig car mi 'byung ba'i phyir dang / khro sogs nye nyon bcu tshan dang po lta bu la'ang /

gtso sems gcig gi 'khor du de bcu gang rung gcig byung sar gzhan mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang / dge bar gyur pa'i gtso sems yin na/ khyod kyi 'khor du byung ba'i dad sogs dge ba bcu gcig yod pas khyab pa dang / mi dge bar gyur pa'i gtso sems yin na khyod kyi 'khor du/ ngo tsha med pa dang / khrel med kyi sems byung gnyis yod pas khyab/ nyon mongs can gyi gtso sems yin na/ khyod kyi 'khor du byung ba'i ma rig pa yod pas khyab bo/ /gnad des na/ dge ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / mi dge ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / bsgribs lung ma bstan gyi rnam par shes pa gsum po gang rung yin na/ yid gtad pa'am yid sngon song gi rnam par shes pa yin pas khyab/ ma bsgribs lung ma bstan gyi rnam shes la/ rkyen nyer gnas sam yid ma gtad pa'i rnam shes dang / yid gtad pa'am yid sngon song gi rnam shes gnyis char yod pa ni gnad kyi don du shes dgos so/ /gnyis pa mtshungs ldan rnam pa lnga mtshungs la dpyad pa ni/ sngon 'dzin mig gi rnam shes dang / de'i 'khor du byung ba'i sems byung tshor ba gnyis mtshungs ldan rnam pa lnga mtshungs yin te/ de gnyis dmigs pa sngon po la dmigs par mtshungs/ rnam pa sngon po'i rnam ldan du mtshungs/ rten bdag rkyen mig dbang la brten par mtshungs/ dus skye 'gag gnas gsum cig char du byed par mtshungs/ rdzas gcig tu mtshungs pa'i phyir/ des na khyod rnam shes sam gtso sems yin na/ khyod dang khyod kyi 'khor du byung ba'i sems byung gnyis/ dmigs pa/ rnam pa/ rten/ dus rdzas mtshungs pa ste mtshungs ldan rnam pa lnga mtshungs yin pas khyab bo/ /gsum pa khams dang sa gang na sems dang sems byung du yod la dpyad pa ni/ 'dod pa'i sas bsdus kyi sems rnam shes tshogs brgyad/ sems byung lnga bcu rtsa gcig dang thams cad yod/ bsam gtan dang po'i sas bsdus kyi sems rnam shes tshogs brgyad char yod cing /

rtsa nyon drug las zhe sdang / nye nyon bcu tshan dang po'i bdun/ bcu tshan gnyis pa'i dang po lnga rnams bsam gtan dang po'i sas bsdus pa na med de/ bsam gtan dang po'i sas bsdus kyi mi dge ba med pa gang zhig sems byung bcu gsum po de la mi dge ba yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ gzhan 'gyur bzhi'i zlas phye ba'i gnyid 'gyod gnyis bsam gtan dang po na med cing / bsam gtan dang po'i dngos kyi khyad par can na/ gzhan 'gyur bzhi'i zlas phye ba'i rtog pa med la/ bsam gtan gnyis pa yan chad na sngar bshad pa'i sems byung mi dge ba bcu gsum/ gzhan 'gyur bzhi dang bcas pa'i bcu bdun med cing / lhag ma rnams ni ci rigs par yod de/ mdzod las/ de la 'gyod gnyid mi dge rnams/ /bsam gtan dang po dag na med/ /rtog med bsam gtan khyad par can/ /de yi gong na dpyod pa yang / /zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /sems byung de dag las/ lta ba phyi ma gsum la mthong spang gis khyab pa dang / nye nyon bcu tshan dang po la mthong spang dang sgom spang gnyis char yod pa dang / sems byung lnga bcu rtsa gcig las mi dge bar mtha' gcig tu nges pa'i sems byung bcu gsum yod pa rnams ni/ re zhig dpal 'bum phrag gsum pa'i sems sems byung gi zur bkol ltar bris pa yin la/ ji ltar nges kyi dpyad pa ni gzhan du 'chad par byed do/ /gsum pa blos yul rtogs tshul 'chad pa la bzhi/ spyi dang bye brag gi rtogs tshul/ snang ba dang sel ba'i rtogs tshul/ brjod bya dang rjod byed kyi rtogs tshul/ 'gal ba dang 'brel ba'i rtogs tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis/ spyi bshad pa dang / bye brag bshad pa'o/ /de la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ bum pa de dngos med las kyang log dngos po'i nang tshan ka ba las kyang log pa'i ldog pa gnyis tshogs yin pa de/ bum pa dngos po'i bye brag yin pa'i mtshan nyid yin zhing / dngos po de dngos min pa las log pa'i ldog pa chig rkyang yin pa de/

dngos po de spyi yin pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye ba 'chad pa la/ spyi'i dbye ba dang / bye brag gi dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la sgra'i brjod rigs kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang / bye brag gi sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ rigs spyi/ tshogs spyi/ don spyi dang gsum/ dang po dang spyi gnyis don gcig mtshan gzhi bum pa la byed/ gnyis pa dang rags pa don gcig mtshan gzhi gzugs sgra sogs la byed/ gsum pa sgra spyi/ sgra don gsum don gcig mtshan nyid bum 'dzin rtog pa la bum par snang ba lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa bye brag gi sgo nas dbye na/ thad ka'i spyi dang gong ma'i spyi gnyis yod/ dang po ni/ dngos po de ka bum gnyis kyi spyi yin pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ dngos po dang bum pa skad cig snga phyi gnyis kyi spyi yin pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa bye brag la dbye na/ thad ka'i bye brag dang gong ma'i bye brag gnyis/ dang po ni/ sha pa dang / tsandan gnyis shing gi bye brag yin pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ sha pa skad cig snga phyi gnyis shing gi bye brag yin pa lta bu la byed/ des na/ spyi bye brag gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i spyi dang / bye brag gnyis la dngos po dang dngos med gnyis char yod la/ 'on kyang spyi dang gsal ba gnyis kyis zlas phye ba'i spyi yin na dngos med yin pas khyab pa dang / de gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i bsal ba yin na/ rang mtshan yin pas khyab/ ces pa ni gnad kyi snying por shes par bya zhing / dngos po lta bu'i bye brag yin pa la/ kho dngos po yin pa/ dngos po dang bdag gcig tu 'brel ba kho ma yin zhing dngos po yin pa du ma grub pa dgos zhes pa ni/ bsdus pa smra ba dag gis rang dgar smras pa yin gyi/ skabs 'dir khas blang bar mi bya ste/ dngos po skad cig ma gnyis pa de/ dngos po dang bdag gcig 'brel min yang dngos po'i bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ de sgrub pa la/ dngos po skad cig ma gnyis pa chos can/

khyod dngos po'i bye brag yin par thal/ khyod dngos po'i nang tshan gang zhig dngos med las kyang log dngos po'i skad cig gsum sogs las kyang log pa'i ldog pa gnyis tshogs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa snang ba dang sel ba'i rtogs tshul 'chad par byed pa la/ yul can snang 'jug dang / sel 'jug bshad pa dang / yul snang ba dang sel ba bshad pa gnyis/ dang po snang 'jug la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang yul la gsal bar snang ba'i sgo nas 'jug pa de/ snang 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa dbye na 'phags pa'i gang zag dang / rtog med shes pa gnyis/ gnyis pa sel 'jug la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang yul la dmigs par snang ba'i sgo nas 'jug pa de sel 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa dbye na/ rtog pa/ rjod byed kyi sgra/ so so skye bo dang gsum/ /gnyis pa yul snang sel gnyis 'chad pa la/ snang ba dang / sel ba bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtog med shes pa la gsal bar snang ba'i sgo nas rig par bya ba de/ spyir snang ba tsam gyi mtshan nyid yin la/ de dang shes bya don gcig rtog med shes pa la yul gsal bar snang ba'i 'dzin stangs de/ snang sel gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i snang ba'i mtshan nyid yin zhing / snang sel gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i snang ba la shes pas khyab pa dang / de gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i sel ba la spyi mtshan gyis khyab ste/ rigs gter rang 'grel las/ snang ba rtog med shes pa'i 'dzin stangs yin pas don la med do zhe na/ sel ba'ang rtog pa'i 'dzin stangs yin pas don la med do zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /snang sel gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i snang ba la dbye na/ rtog med ma 'khrul shes la snang ba'i gsal snang dang / rtog med 'khrul shes la snang ba'i gsal snang gnyis yod/ gnyis pa sel ba 'chad pa la/ gzhan sel la mtshan nyid/ rnam grangs/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gzhan ldog gzhan sel gyi mtshan nyid yin/

gnyis pa ni/ snang sel gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i sel ba/ gzhan sel/ gzhan zlog gsum don gcig gnyis pa dbye ba la/ sgra'i brjod rigs kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang / dgag bya'i sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ med dgag gi gzhan sel dang / blo'i gzhan sel/ don rang mtshan gyi gzhan sel dang gsum/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid/ rnam grangs/ mtshan gzhi dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gzhan sel gang zhig rang gi dgag bya bkag shul du chos gzhan mi 'phen pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa ni/ med dgag med dgag gi gzhan sel/ sel ba'i dgag pa gsum don gcig gsum pa ni/ bum pa bum pa min pas stong pa de/ bum pa'i med dgag gi gzhan sel yin pa lta bu ste/ khyod gzhi grub na khyod kyi med dgag gi gzhan sel yod pas khyab ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa blo'i gzhan sel la mtshan nyid/ rnam grangs/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gzhan sel dang don spyi'i gzhi mthun par tshad mas dmigs pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ blo'i gzhan sel/ sgra'i gzhan sel/ don spyi/ sgra spyi/ sgra don lnga don gcig gsum pa dbye ba la/ dngos po la brten pa'i blo'i gzhan sel dang / dngos med la brten pa'i blo'i gzhan sel gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid/ rnam grangs/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ blo'i gzhan sel gang zhig rang gzhan sel du 'jog pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i dngos po yod pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ dngos po la brten pa'i blo'i gzhan sel/ dngos po la brten pa'i sgra'i gzhan sel/ dngos po'i gzhan sel/ yod pa gzhan sel dang bzhi don gcig gsum pa dbye na/ snang ba mngon gyur gyi dngos po la brten pa'i blo'i gzhan sel dang / mi snang ba lkog gyur gyi dngos po la brten pa'i blo'i gzhan sel gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhan sel gang zhig rang gzhan sel du 'jog pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i mngon gyur gyi dngos po yod pa de de'i mtshan nyid/

gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ bum 'dzin mngon sum gyis drangs nas skyes pa'i bum pa dran pa'i dran shes la bum pa bum par snang ba lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa mi snang ba lkog gyur gyi dngos po la brten pa'i gzhan sel la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhan sel gang zhig rang gzhan sel du 'jog pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i lkog gyur gyi dngos po yod pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa dbye na/ bden pa la 'jug pa rjes dpag gi yul du gyur pa'i dngos po'i gzhan sel/ rdzun pa la 'jug pa log shes kyi yul du gyur pa'i dngos po'i gzhan sel/ gnyis kar dogs pa the tshom gyi yul du gyur pa'i dngos po'i gzhan sel dang gsum/ mtshan gzhi rim bzhin/ bum pa rtogs pa'i rjes dpag la bum pa bum par snang ba lta bu dang / bum 'dzin rtog pa log shes la bum pa bum par snang ba lta bu dang / bum 'dzin the tshom la bum pa bum par snang ba lta bu la byed/ des na gnad dril na/ snang ba mngon gyur gyi dngos po la brten pa'i gzhan sel/ mi snang ba lkog gyur gyi dngos po la brten pa'i gzhan sel/ dngos po la brten pa'i gzhan sel gsum don gcig ste/ mngon gyur gyi dngos po/ lkog gyur gyi dngos po/ dngos po dang gsum don gcig pa'i phyir te/ mngon gyur/ lkog gyur/ shes bya gsum don gcig pa'i phyir te/ shes bya yin na/ mngon sum la mngon gyur yin pas khyab/ rjes dpag la lkog gyur yin pas khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa dngos med la brten pa'i gzhan sel la mtshan nyid/ rnam grangs/ dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ blo'i gzhan sel gang zhig rang gzhan sel du 'jog pa'i gzhi yang yin/ dngos med kyang yin pa'i gzhi mthun srid pa'i rigs su gnas pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ dngos med la brten pa'i gzhan sel/ dngos med kyi gzhan sel/ med pa gzhan sel gsum don gcig gnyis pa dbye na/ dgag bya shes bya la srid pa'i dngos med la brten pa'i gzhan sel dang /

dgag bya shes bya la mi srid pa'i dngos med la brten pa'i gzhan sel gnyis/ dang po ni/ bum pa med pa'i don spyi lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ ri bong rwa med pa'i don spyi lta bu la byed/ gsum pa don rang mtshan gyi gzhan sel la mtshan nyid/ rnam grangs/ mtshan gzhi gsum/ dang po ni/ rtog pas dngos 'gal bcad nas 'jug pa'i gzhi yang yin/ don la grub pa yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun par tshad mas dmigs pa de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ de dang dngos po gnyis don gcig mtshan gzhi ni bum pa lta bu la byed/ des na/ don rang mtshan gyi gzhan sel yin na/ gzhan sel ma yin pas khyab ste/ don rang mtshan gyi gzhan sel yin na/ rang mtshan yin pas khyab/ gzhan sel yin na spyi mtshan yin pas khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gzhan sel la/ blo'i gzhan sel dang / med dgag gi gzhan sel/ ma yin dgag gi gzhan sel gsum po gang rung yin pas khyab ste/ don rang mtshan gyi gzhan sel yin na/ gzhan sel min dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa dgag bya'i sgo nas dbye na/ med dgag gi gzhan sel dang / ma yin dgag gi gzhan sel gnyis/ dang po bshad zin/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang mtshan gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhan sel gang zhig rang gi dgag bya bkag shul du chos gzhan 'phen pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ bum 'dzin rtog pa la bum min bcad nas bum pa bum par snang ba lta bu la byed/ des na gnad kyi snying po bsdus na/ snang ba'i sgrub pa dang / sel ba'i sgrub pa gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i sel ba'i sgrub pa dang / med dgag dang / ma yin dgag gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i ma yin dgag dang / ma yin dgag gi gzhan sel dang dgag sgrub nyis tshogs dang / dgag pa rkyang pa gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i dgag sgrub nyis tshogs dang bzhi don gcig tu khas blangs nas/ spyi mtshan dang gzhan sel don gcig tu khas blangs pas chog la de ltar na/ spyi mtshan nam gzhan sel yin na/ ma yin dgag gi gzhan sel dang /

med dgag gi gzhan sel gnyis po gang rung yin pas khyab cing / blo'i gzhan sel yin na/ ma yin dgag gi gzhan sel yin pas khyab/ ma yin dgag gi gzhan sel la/ blo'i gzhan sel gyis ma khyab ste/ shes bya dang / gzhal bya sogs ma yin dgag gi gzhan sel yin yang / blo'i gzhan sel min pa'i phyir/ gnad des na/ snang ba'i sgrub pa dang / sel ba'i sgrub pa gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i snang ba'i sgrub pa dang dngos po don gcig dgag sgrub nyis tshogs dang / dgag rkyang gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i dgag rkyang dang / med dgag don gcig ces pa ni/ dpal 'bum phrag gsum pa'i dgongs pa dang sbyar ba'i tshad ma rigs pa'i gter gyi gzhung don bla na med pa yin te/ rigs gter rtsa bar/ snang ba dngos po'i yul can yin/ /sel ba la ni dgag sgrub gnyis/ /zhes dang / rang 'grel las/ des na sel ba'i dgag sgrub gnyis dang / med dgag ma yin dgag gnyis don gcig ces gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na deng sang / ma yin dgag dang / sgrub pa don gcig tu smras pa yang snying po med de/ snang ba'i sgrub pa rnams grub pa yin yang / ma yin dgag ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /don 'di dag la dogs pa 'di ltar dpyad dgos te/ bum pa chos can/ dngos po la brten pa'i blo'i gzhan sel yin par thal/ dngos po'i gzhan sel yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ don rang mtshan gyi gzhan sel gang zhig don rang mtshan dang dngos po gnyis don gcig pa'i phyir zer na/ bum pa chos can/ khyod mi rtag pa'i gzhan sel yin par thal/ khyod don rang mtshan gyi gzhan sel gang zhig mi rtag pa dang / don rang mtshan gnyis don gcig pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ 'dod na gzhan sel yin par thal lo/ /yang dngos po'i don spyi chos can/ don rang mtshan gyi gzhan sel yin par thal/ dngos po'i gzhan sel gang zhig dngos po dang / don rang mtshan don gcig pa'i phyir/ khyab pa dngos/ 'dod na/ rang mtshan du thal lo/

/rtags dang po ma grub na/ dngos po chos can/ khyod kyi don spyi dngos po'i gzhan sel dang / yod pa gzhan sel dang / dngos po la brten pa'i gzhan sel gnyis char yin par thal/ khyod dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa rigs gter las/ dngos po'i gzhan sel dngos med yod/ /ces pa dang / rnam 'grel las/ dngos dang dngos med gnyis ka la'ang / /rten gyi spyi de'ang rnam pa gsum/ /zhes bshad pas grub bo/ /yang / dngos po dngos po min pas stong pa chos can/ khyod dngos po la brten pa'i blo'i gzhan sel yin par thal/ khyod dngos po'i gzhan sel yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod dngos po'i med dgag gi gzhan sel yin pa'i phyir zer na/ don rang mtshan don rang mtshan ma yin pas stong pa chos can/ khyod don rang mtshan gyi gzhan sel yin par thal/ khyod don rang mtshan gyi med dgag gi gzhan sel yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa dngos/ yang blo blo min pas stong pa chos can/ khyod blo'i gzhan sel yin par thal/ khyod blo'i med dgag gi gzhan sel yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa dngos/ rtags khas/ 'dod mi nus te khyod med dgag gi gzhan sel yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang dngos med dngos med ma yin pas stong pa chos can/ khyod dngos med la brten pa'i blo'i gzhan sel yin par thal/ khyod dngos med kyi gzhan sel yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod dngos med kyi med dgag gi gzhan sel yin pa'i phyir zer na mtshungs pa snga ma bzhin gtong bas sla'o/ /yang blo'i gzhan sel yin na/ dngos po la brten pa'i blo'i gzhan sel dang / dngos med la brten pa'i blo'i gzhan sel gang rung yin dgos par thal/ blo sel la de gnyis su grangs nges pa'i phyir/ 'dod na shes bya'i don spyi chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod de gnyis gang rung min par thal/ khyod dngos po dang dngos med gnyis ka la brten pa'i blo'i gzhan sel yin pa'i phyir zer na/

ma khyab ste/ rnam 'grel las/ rten chos can de la/ mtha' gcig tu dngos por nges pa/ dngos med du nges pa/ de gnyis ka'i cha yod pa gsum yod pa'i cha nas/ dngos dang dngos med gnyis ka la/ /brten phyir spyi de'ang rnam pa gsum/ /zhes gsum du bshad pa tsam yin gyi/ rten chos can thams cad/ dngos po dang / dngos med gnyis su bsdus pa'i cha nas/ dngos po'i gzhan sel dang / dngos med kyi gzhan sel gnyis su rigs gter las bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /yang ri bong rwa'i don spyi chos can/ khyod dngos po la brten pa'i blo'i gzhan sel yin par thal/ khyod blo'i gzhan sel gang zhig khyod dngos med la brten pa'i blo'i gzhan sel ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khyod gzhan sel du 'jog pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i dngos po yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ rtags phyi ma ma grub na/ ri bong rwa chos can/ khyod 'dzin rtog pa la khyod dngos med du snang bar thal/ khyod kyi don spyi de/ dngos med la brten pa'i blo sel yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mi snang bar thal/ khyod 'dzin rtog pa la khyod dngos por snang ba'i phyir te/ khyod 'dzin rtog pa la khyod ri bong rwar snang ba'i phyir zer na/ 'di ltar sems te/ khyod dngos po yin na/ khyod kyi don spyi de dngos po la brten pa'i blo sel yin pas khyab/ khyod dngos med yin na/ khyod kyi don spyi dngos med la brten pa'i blo sel yin pas ma khyab ste/ ri bong rwa/ mo gsham bu/ nam mkha'i padma sogs kyi don spyi ni/ dngos po la brten pa'i blo sel yin pa'i phyir te/ ri bong rwa sogs 'dzin pa'i rtog pa la/ ri bong rwa sogs dngos med yin pa bcad nas dngos por snang ba'i phyir/ khyab ste/ dngos po'i gzhan sel dngos med gcod/ /ces bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na/ ri bong rwa sogs kyi don spyi/ gzhan sel du 'jog pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i dngos po gang yin snyam na/

spyir rwa tsam dang / bum tsam dang / padma tsam zhig yin zhes smra bar rigs te/ ri bong rwa rwa min pa bcad nas rwar snang ba'i phyir dang / nam mkha'i padma 'dzin pa'i rtog pa la/ de padma min pa bcad nas padmar snang ba'i phyir ro/ /yang na/ ri bong rwa 'dzin rtog ngor ri bong rwa de nyid/ ri bong rwa'i don spyi gzhan sel du 'jog pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i dngos po yin te/ de'i ngor de dngos po yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang gzhan sel yin na/ blo'i gzhan sel dang / med dgag gi gzhan sel gang rung yin pas khyab par thal/ gzhan sel la de gnyis su grangs nges pa'i phyir na ma grub/ 'dod na/ shes bya chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na der thal/ ma yin dgag gi gzhan sel yin pa'i phyir te/ ma yin dgag yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ des na sel ba'i dgag sgrub gnyis dang med dgag ma yin dgag gnyis don gcig ces bshad pa'i phyir/ rtsa rtags der thal/ sgrub par gyur pa'i spyi mtshan yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang shes bya chos can/ khyod gzhan sel yin par thal/ khyod sel ba'i sgrub pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste sel ba'i dgag pa yin na/ gzhan sel yin dgos pa'i phyir/ gong gi rtags der thal/ sgrub pa gang zhig snang ba'i sgrub pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma ma grub na rang mtshan du thal lo/ /yang khyod 'dzin rtog pa la khyod du snang ba de khyod kyi blo'i gzhan sel yin par thal/ khyod kyi blo'i gzhan sel yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la khyab pa yod par thal/ khyod khyod min pas stong pa de khyod kyi med dgag gi gzhan sel yin par thal/ khyod kyi med dgag gi gzhan sel yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la khyab pa yod pa'i phyir na ma grub/ 'dod na/ mngon gyur/ gsal ba/ mngon sum gsum chos can du bzung nas gshogs/ rtags sla/ 'dod na/ de gsum 'dzin pa'i rtog pa la de gsum du snang ba yod par thal lo/ /'dod na/

mngon gyur 'dzin pa'i rtog pa chos can/ khyod la mngon gyur du snang ba med par thal/ khyod rtog pa yin pa'i phyir/ des gzhan gnyis la'ang 'gre/ rtsa bar ma khyab na/ ka bum gnyis ka chos can gyis gshogs/ rtags khas blangs/ 'dod na/ ka bum gnyis ka ka bum gnyis ka min pas stong pa yod par thal/ 'dod na/ de yin pa yod par thal lo/ /'dir mkhas pa go bo rab 'byams pas/ dngos med kyi gzhan sel dang / med dgag gi gzhan sel don gcig tu mdzad pa ni/ mkhas pas dpyad dgos te/ 'o na dngos po'i gzhan sel dang / ma yin dgag gi gzhan sel don gcig par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ shes bya'i don spyi chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ shes bya chos can/ khyod 'dzin rtog pa la khyod dngos por snang bar thal/ khyod kyi don spyi de dngos po'i gzhan sel yin pa'i phyir/ gnad 'di dran dgos so/ /gnyis pa brjod bya dang rjod byed kyi rtogs tshul 'chad par byed pa la/ de gnyis la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ brda las go bar bya ba/ brjod bya'i mtshan nyid/ go bar byed pa'i brda de rjod byed kyi mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ thun mong gi dbye ba dang / rjod byed kyi dbye ba bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ 'chad dus kyi brjod bya rjod byed dang 'jug dus kyi brjod bya rjod byed gnyis/ dang po la/ dngos kyi brjod bya rjod byed dang zhen pa'i brjod bya rjod byed gnyis/ de yang dper mtshon na/ bum pa'i don spyi de/ bum pa zhes brjod pa'i sgra'i dngos kyi brjod bya yin te/ de de'i song tshod kyi brjod bya yin pa'i phyir/ bum pa de de'i zhen pa'i brjod bya yin te/ de de'i rlom tshod kyi brjod bya yin pa'i phyir/ bum pa zhes brjod pa'i sgra de/ dngos kyi rjod byed yin te/ des bum pa dang / bum pa'i don spyi gnyis char dngos su brjod pa'i phyir/

bum 'dzin rtog pa la snang ba'i sgra spyi de/ zhen pa'i rjod byed yin te/ des de brjod byar rlom pa'i phyir/ 'o na rigs gter las/ rang mtshan rjod byed sgra'i dngos kyi brjod bya min par bshad pa yin nam snyam na/ ma yin te/ sgra don dang rang mtshan gnyis kyi nang nas rang mtshan rkyang pa rjod byed sgra'i dngos kyi brjod bya min pa tsam la dgongs nas/ sgra yi rang mtshan nyid brjod na/ /mig dbang la sogs dgos med 'gyur/ /zhes sogs bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa 'jug pa'i tshe na/ bum pa zhes brjod pa'i sgra de/ bum pa'i rjod byed dang / bum pa de de'i brjod bya yin zhes pa tsam zhig khas blang gi dngos zhen so sor mi 'chad de rigs gter las/ 'chad na gnyis su yod mod kyi/ /'jug pa'i tshe na rnam dbye med/ /ces bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rjod byed kyi dbye ba bye brag tu bshad pa la/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba/ brjod bya'i sgo nas dbye ba/ rjod tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ byed las kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang bzhi/ dang po la/ yi ge ming tshig gsum/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ don gyi ngo bo dang khyad par gang yang mi ston zhing / ming tshig gnyis kyi gzhir gyur pa'i skad gdangs de/ ming tshig yi ge gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i yi ge'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa dbye na/ rgyud sde'i lugs/ sgra pa'i lugs/ sdeb sbyor pa'i lugs/ sum rtags kyi lugs dang bzhi/ dang po la/ dbyangs yig bcu drug dang / gsal byed bzhi bcu yod/ gnyis pa la dbyangs yig bcu bzhi dang / gsal byed so bdun yod/ gsum pa la dbyangs yig nyi shu rtsa gnyis dang / gsal byed so bdun yod/ bzhi pa bod yig gi mkhan po thon mi saṃ bho ṭa'i sum rtags ltar na/ dbyangs yig bzhi dang / gsal byed sum cu tham pa yod do/ /dang po ni/ i o e u dang bzhi la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ ka nas a'i bar sum cu de la byed do/

/gnyis pa ming la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ yi ge du ma 'dus pa las don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i mnyan bya de ming tshig yi ge gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i ming gi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa dbye na dngos ming dang / btags ming gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ don de la thog mar brda sbyar zhing don de 'khrul med du go nus kyi mnyan bya de/ don de'i dngos ming gi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa dbye na/ bshad pa rgyu mtshan can gyi ming / 'jug pa rgyu mtshan can gyi ming / bshad 'jug mu bzhi bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa zhes pa'i ming lta bu/ gnyis pa ni shing zhes pa'i ming lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ mtsho skyes zhes pa'i sgra lta bu la mtshon na/ mtsho skyes kyi sgra bshad du yod la 'jug tu med pa'i mu de 'jug tu yod la bshad du med pa'i mu/ bshad 'jug gnyis char yod pa'i mu/ gnyis char med pa'i mu dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ mtsho las skyes pa'i sbal pa lta bu ste/ de la mtsho skyes kyi sgra bshad du yod de mtsho las skyes pa'i phyir/ de 'jug tu med de mtsho skyes dngos min pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni skam las skyes pa'i padma lta bu ste/ de la mtsho skyes kyi sgra 'jug tu yod de/ de mtsho skyes yin pa'i phyir/ bshad du med de/ de mtsho las ma skyes pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ mtsho las skyes pa'i pad ma lta bu ste/ de la mtsho skyes kyi sgra bshad 'jug gnyis char yod de/ mtsho las skyes pa'i phyir dang / mtsho skyes sam padma dngos yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni skam las skyes pa'i srog chags lta bu ste/ mtsho las ma skyes pa'i phyir dang padma min pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa btags ming la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ don de la rjes grub tu brda sbyar zhing don de la 'khrul bcas su go nus kyi mnyan bya de de'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa dbye na/

ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba dang / rgyu mtshan gyi sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la rjes grub kyi 'dod rgyal gyi ming dang / rjes grub kyi don ldan gyi ming gnyis/ dang po ni/ khyi la dung zhes 'dod rgyal du btags pa'i ming lta bu/ gnyis pa ni khyi dkar po la dung zhes btags pa'i ming lta bu la byed/ des na don de'i 'dod rgyal ba'i ming yin na don de'i dngos ming yin pas khyab ste/ smra sgo mtshon cha las/ de yang ming gi thog ma dang / /rjes su grub pa rnam pa gnyis/ /thog ma 'dod rgyal ming yin te/ /rjes grub dag ni 'dod rgyal dang / /don ldan gnyis kar 'dod pa yin/ /zhes thog ma'i ming la 'dod rgyal gyi ming yin pas khyab cing / rjes grub kyi ming la 'dod rgyal dang / don ldan gnyis yod ces bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa'i ming dang / 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa'i ming gnyis/ dang po ni/ sman bya rog rkang zhes pa'i ming lta bu/ gnyis pa la rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa dang / tshogs pa'i 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa'i ming gnyis/ dang po la/ rgyu ming 'bras bu la btags pa/ nyi ma'i 'od zer la nyi ma zhes btags pa'i ming lta bu dang / 'bras ming rgyu la btags pa/ chang la myos 'gyur dang / sgrub ngag yang dag la gzhan don rjes dpag btags pa'i ming lta bu gnyis yod/ gnyis pa la yang / tshogs pa'i ming ya gyal la btags pa/ shes 'dod chos can dang / sgrub chos la phyogs kyi ming btags pa lta bu dang / ya gyal gyi ming tshogs pa la btags pa/ ras yug gi phyogs gcig tshig pa la ras yug tshig ces btags pa'i ming lta bu gnyis yod do/ /gsum pa tshig la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ ming du ma 'dus pa la brten nas don gyi khyad par ston pa'i mnyan bya de/ ming tshig yi ge gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i tshig gi mtshan nyid yin/ des na/

spyir ming tshig yi ge ngag rjod byed kyi sgra rnams don gcig kyang / ming tshig yi ge gsum gyi zlas phye ba'i ming tshig yi ge gsum ni/ don mi gcig ste/ mtshan nyid gzhag pa'i nus pa la brtags pas shes pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ byed pa'i tshig tshig gi bsdu ba/ tshig gi phrad dang gsum/ dang po la/ dang po ngo bo ston pa'i tshig gnyis pa bya ba ston pa'i tshig gsum pa byed pa po'i tshig bzhi pa dgos ched kyi tshig lnga pa 'byung khungs kyi tshig drug pa 'brel ba ston pa'i tshig bdun pa gnas gzhi'i tshig brgyad pa bod pa'i tshig dang brgyad/ dang po ni shing zhes pa'i tshig lta bu/ gnyis pa ni shing ring po zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni shing gis gzhan la bsnun zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi pa ni shing la chu drongs zhes pa lta bu/ lnga pa ni shing las me tog byung zhes pa lta bu/ drug pa ni shing gi yal 'dab ces pa lta bu/ bdun pa ni shing la bya tshang gnas zhes pa lta bu/ brgyad pa ni kyai shing khyer shog ces pa'i tshig lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa tshig gi bsdu ba ni/ smra sgo las/ 'bru mang po dang tshig sdud dang / /khyad par dang ni yan lag dang / /gzhi dang gzhi gcig bsdu ba dang / /gzhi mthun dang ni de'i skyes bu/ /zlas dbye ba dang phyogs tsam mo/ /zhes pa ltar bcu yod pa'i dang po 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba ni/ tshig gnyis sam mang po'i bar gyi rnam dbye bsdu ba ste/ lha nor bu padma can zhes bsdus pa'i tshig gis/ phyag na nor bu'i 'phreng ba dang pad ma bsnams pa'i spyan ras gzigs go ba lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa tshig sdud tsam gyi bsdu ba ni/ byed tshig brgyad kyi gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar bsdus pa'i tshig sbyor te dpe rim bzhin/ gnyis pa bsdus pa chos la brten pa la chos brten zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa bsdus pa sangs rgyas kyis bskyangs pa la sangs rgyas bskyangs zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi pa bsdus pa mchog gi phyir sbyor ba la mchog sbyor zhes pa lta bu/

lnga pa bsdus pa chos las byung ba la chos byung zhes pa lta bu/ drug pa bsdus pa chos kyi sgo la chos sgo zhes pa lta bu/ bdun pa bsdus pa chos la gnas pa la chos gnas zhes brjod pa lta bu'o/ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa yan lag gi bsdu ba ni/ 'brel ba'i yan lag gam/ go rim gyi yan lag sdud pa'i tshig ste/ dpe rim bzhin lus la sogs pa'i dbang po zhes pas dbang po lnga go ba dang / gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po zhes pas phung po lnga go ba lta bu'o/ /rtsa ba'i bzhi pa khyad par gyi bsdu ba ni/ khyad chos khyad gzhi la snga phyi gang rung du sbyar nas sdud pa ste/ sngon po 'di ni utpal zhes go ba'i phyir du/ sngon po utpal zhes bsdus pa dang / utpal 'di ni sngon po'o/ /zhes go ba'i phyir du utpal sngon po zhes bsdus pa lta bu'o/ /rtsa ba'i lnga pa gzhi bsdu ba ni/ khyad gzhi mang po bsdus pa'i tshig ste/ chos mtha' dag ces pa lta bu'o/ /rtsa ba'i drug pa gzhi gcig bsdu ba ni/ khyad gzhi rnams khyad chos gcig tu sdud pa'i tshig ste 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag ces pa'i tshig lta bu'o/ /rtsa ba'i bdun pa gzhi mthun pa'i bsdu ba ni/ khyad gzhi dang khyad chos gnyis gzhi gcig tu sbyor ba'am/ khyad chos gnyis khyad gzhi gcig tu sbyor ba ste/ dper na sngo ba dang utpal gnyis ka utpal lo zhes pa dang / sngo ba dang btsub pa gnyis ka utpal lo zhes pa lta bu rim bzhin no/ /rtsa ba'i brgyad pa de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba ni/ smra sgo las/ ngo bo'am ni chos kyang rung / /tha dad go bar byed pa la/ /de yi skyes bu gsum yin te/ /byed pa'i tshig dang las 'dzin dang / /bdag gnyis pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes pa ltar/ ngo bo tha dad par ram/ ngo bo gcig gi khyad chos gnyis tha dad par sbyor ba ni/ de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba zhes bya la/ de la dbye na/ byed pa'i tshig gi bsdu ba/ las 'dzin gyi bsdu ba/ bdag gnyis pa'i bsdu ba dang gsum/

dang po la/ byed tshig brgyad kyi nang tshan gyi gnyis pa bsdus pa'i de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba nas/ bdun pa bsdus pa'i de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba'i bar drug yod pa'i/ mtshan gzhi rim bzhin/ chos la brten pa la chos brten zhes sogs sngar dang 'dra ste/ gnyis pa las su bya ba'i tshig mi mngon par bsdus pa dang / gsum pa byed pa po'i tshig mi mngon par bsdus pa sogs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnad 'di dran dgos so/ /gnyis pa las 'dzin gyi bsdu ba ni/ khyad gzhi dang khyad par ram/ 'dra yul dang 'dra chos gzhi mthun du sbyor ba ste/ utpal yang yin sngon 'dzin sngon po yang yin pa la utpal sngon po zhes bsdus pa lta bu dang / skyes bu yang yin seng ge dang 'dra ba yang yin pa la skyes bu seng ge zhes bsdus pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa gnyis pa'i bsdu ba ni/ grangs kyi ba dang / bsdus pa yod pa'i ba gnyis gcig gam tha dad par sbyor ba ste/ lnga zhes pa grangs dang / phung po zhes pa bsdus don gnyis sbyar ba la phung po lnga zhes bsdus pa lta bu'o/ /rtsa ba'i dgu pa zlas phye ba'i bsdu ba ni/ rang gi zla bo dang dbye ba'i phyir ram sdud pa'i phyir du ngang gis bsdu ba byas pa ste/ zla bo dbye ba'i phyir du chos ni 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'o zhes pa lta bu dang / sdud pa'i phyir du sa dang chu dang me dang rlung ni 'byung ba'o zhes pa lta bu'o/ /rtsa ba'i bcu pa phyogs tsam ston pa'i bsdu ba ni/ rang gi phyogs bsdus nas gzhan phyogs spong ba'i tshig sdud de/ sems tsam zhes pa des sems kyi rigs bsdus na bem po sogs spong ba lta bu'o/ /gsum pa tshig phrad ni tshig rang nyid la bstan bya'i nus pa cher med cing / tshig grogs gzhan dang phrad na phan 'dogs pa lcags gnyis sbyor ba'i rtsi lta bu ste/ de yang cung zad dper mtshon na/ smra sgo las/ ste ni lhag ma yod pa ste/ /mtshams sbyor ba dang dam bca' dang /

/gzhan brten pa dang gsum du 'dod/ /ces pa ltar/ ste zhes pa'i tshig phrad ni/ lhag ma lus pa'i tshig ste/ de yang gsum la 'jug ste/ 'dzum dmul te mdangs phyung zhes pa lta bu mtshams sbyor ba dang / phyag 'tshal te bstan bcos rtsom zhes pa lta bu dam bca' ba dang / shar na dbang po ste lho na gshin rje yod ces pa lta bu gzhan 'dren pa dang gsum la 'jug pa lta bu dang / yang las tshig rgyu dang 'byung khungs dang / /dgar ba yin te nas de bzhin/ /zhes pa ltar/ las zhes pa'i tshig phrad ni gsum la 'jug ste/ sa bon las myu gu 'byung zhes pa lta bu rgyu'i tshig dang / ri bo las gser 'byung zhes pa lta bu 'byung khungs kyi tshig dang / khyim pa las dge bsnyen zhes pa lta bu dgar pa'i tshig dang gsum la 'jug pa lta bu'o/ /yang kyi ni 'brel ba'i don yin te/ /kyis ni byed par 'dod pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ kyi zhes pa'i tshig phrad ni/ drug pa 'brel ba ston pa'i tshig ste/ lhas sbyin gyi rta zhes pa lta bu'o/ /drug pa'i tshig 'di la sa sgra sbyar na nor bar 'gyur ro/ /kyis zhes pa'i tshig phrad ni/ gsum pa byed po'i tshig ste/ lha sbyin gyis legs bshad brtsams zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa'i tshig 'di la sa sgra chad na/ nor ba lags so/ /des na mkhas par 'dod na/ tshig phrad kyi rnam dbye so sor phyed pa zhig gnad du gces te/ 'dir ni mangs pas 'jigs te bzhag go /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa rjod byed kyi sgra la brjod bya'i sgo nas dbye na/ rigs brjod kyi sgra dang / tshogs brjod kyi sgra gnyis/ de gnyis la mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ mu bzhi rtsi ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rigs spyi go bar nus pa'i mnyan bya de/ rigs brjod kyi sgra'i mtshan nyid/ tshogs spyi go nus kyi mnyan bya de/ tshogs brjod kyi sgra'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa mtshan gzhi ni/ dngos po zhes pa'i sgra lta bu ste/ khyod rigs spyi yin na/ khyod ces brjod pa'i sgra rigs brjod kyi sgra yin pas khyab/
